note: Bits farmed from other morning shows, rewritten as JB & Sandy Austin versions. Items older than 7 days drop to the archive. Newest first.

items.title: What time should coffee shops open?
items.how: The show argues the right opening time for a coffee shop.
items.ours: We are on at 6. Name the Austin coffee spots that are not open yet when we are. Phones: what time should they open?

items.title: Today Years Old
items.how: Hosts reveal facts they only just learned and how old they were when they found out.
items.ours: JB and Sandy each confess one fact they learned embarrassingly late. Phones: how old were you?

items.title: Can you tickle yourself?
items.how: Light studio test and caller reactions about tickling yourself.
items.ours: Quick live test on air with JB. Short and silly, good for a tease.

items.title: Second Date Update: the Microwaved Salad Guy
items.how: Caller got ghosted after a first date. The show calls the date to find out why, and the reason is the punchline.
items.ours: Our version: Ghosted, Austin edition. Listener submits a date that went quiet, we call and find out. Phones: weirdest date habit you have seen.

items.title: Phone tap: the misspelled proposal fortune cookie
items.how: Prank call blaming a guy for the typo that turned his fiancee's name into Dennis.
items.ours: Not a prank (we skip those), but a phones topic: worst typo on something important, like a cake, a tattoo or a wedding invite.

items.title: Half your office is now her closet
items.how: Prank where a closet installer says the wife put a deposit down to turn half his office into her closet.
items.ours: Phones: who won the space war in your house? Garage, office or closet. Sandy and JB each pick a side.

pick.title: MIC DROP: turning a canceled concert into a game
pick.how: Payton was bummed Charli XCX canceled her Phoenix show, so she built an on-air game around it to vent.
pick.ours: When a show we wanted gets canceled (or ACL weather wrecks a set), make a quick game of it: callers name the concert that bailed on them, JB and Sandy rate the heartbreak 1 to 10.
